title: India's Envoy to China Rejects Comparison with Pakistan on Iran Mediation
summary: India's envoy to China has rejected comparisons with Pakistan on Iran mediation, citing differences in approach and goals. The envoy's comments come amid tensions between India and Pakistan over the role of Iran in regional conflicts. The Indian government has been critical of Pakistan's involvement in West Asia mediation, while Pakistan has accused India of trying to undermine its efforts. The envoy's rejection of the comparison highlights the complexities of India-Pakistan relations and the need for a nuanced approach to regional diplomacy.
